abstract:
Code accompanying the paper "Learning Agile Robotic Locomotion Skills by Imitating Animals"

# Motion Imitation Further development (new features, bug fixes etc) happen in the master branch. The 'paper' branch of this repository contains the original code accompanying the paper: "Learning Agile Robotic Locomotion Skills by Imitating Animals", by Xue Bin Peng et al. It provides a Gym environment for training a simulated quadruped robot to imitate various reference motions, and example training code for learning the policies. [ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lKYh6uuCwRY&feature=youtu.be&hd=1 "Learning Agile Robotic Locomotion Skills by Imitating Animals") Project page: https://xbpeng.github.io/projects/Robotic_Imitation/index.html ## Getting Started We use this repository with Python 3.7 or Python 3.8 on Ubuntu, MacOS and Windows. - Install MPC extension (Optional) `python3 setup.py install --user` Install dependencies: - Install MPI: `sudo apt install libopenmpi-dev` - Install requirements: `pip3 install -r requirements.txt` and it should be good to go. ## Training Imitation Models To train a policy, run the following command: ``python3 motion_imitation/run.py --mode train --motion_file motion_imitation/data/motions/dog_pace.txt --int_save_freq 10000000 --visualize`` - `--mode` can be either `train` or `test`. - `--motion_file` specifies the reference motion that the robot is to imitate. `motion_imitation/data/motions/` contains different reference motion clips. - `--int_save_freq` specifies the frequency for saving intermediate policies every n policy steps. - `--visualize` enables visualization, and rendering can be disabled by removing the flag. - the trained model and logs will be written to `output/`. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提供一个 Gym 仿真环境与示例训练代码（motion_imitation），让仿真四足机器人模仿 motion_imitation/data/motions/ 下的动物参考运动片段来学习策略：通过 run.py 以 --mode train/test 驱动，--motion_file 指定参考动作，并用 MPI（如 mpiexec -n 8）进行并行采样训练。


# 一、动机

> 传统四足机器人敏捷运动控制多依赖手工设计的步态控制器或轨迹优化，难以泛化到多样化的动态步态；且为每种步态单独设计控制器成本高。该工作希望直接从动物运动捕捉数据中学习参考动作，让机器人以模仿的方式获取敏捷运动技能。


# 二、方法

> 提供一个 Gym 仿真环境与示例训练代码（motion_imitation），让仿真四足机器人模仿 motion_imitation/data/motions/ 下的动物参考运动片段来学习策略：通过 run.py 以 --mode train/test 驱动，--motion_file 指定参考动作，并用 MPI（如 mpiexec -n 8）进行并行采样训练。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 仓库在 Python 3.7/3.8（Ubuntu/MacOS/Windows）下可运行，支持 train 与 test 两种模式，参考动作以文本片段形式提供（如 dog_pace.txt）；支持 MPI 并行（示例 -n 8）与按 --int_save_freq 定期保存中间策略，训练模型与日志写入 output/。原文（Peng et al., 2020）在真实四足机器人上演示了从动物动作迁移得到的多种敏捷步态。


# 四、对我的启发

> 依赖高质量动物动捕参考动作，参考片段质量与 sim-to-real 差距直接决定迁移效果；但「动物动作 → 机器人」的跨具身模仿是一条低成本获取通用运动技能的可行范式，对具身智能中跨本体技能迁移有启发。
